text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer listened to Neo Universe 
explain "Vanishing" in detail. It seemed 
"Vanishing" meant neither injury nor 
retirement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And after that "Disappearance," she 
foresaw the emergence of the "Great King" 
and the "Singularity." ...Even though she 
could see it, she was not there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer senses something amiss in the 
contradiction. Watching her head toward 
the race, they feel a strange sense of 
déjà vu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Does another Trainer also exist in another 
universe? Perhaps this déjà vu is the 
memory of that other person.
